# Local interface fonts

Unmodified fonts downloaded from the official Google Fonts repository on 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-11.
Each family includes its SIL Open Font License 1.1 in `OFL.txt`.

- [Cairo](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cairo): variable weight 200–1000, normal slant. Original `Cairo[slnt,wght].ttf` stored as `Cairo-Variable.ttf` for a portable asset path; the binary is unchanged.
- [Tajawal](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/tajawal): regular 400 and bold 700.
- [IBM Plex Sans Arabic](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/ibmplexsansarabic): regular 400 and bold 700.
- [Noto Naskh Arabic](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notonaskharabic): variable weight 400–700. Original `NotoNaskhArabic[wght].ttf` stored as `NotoNaskhArabic-Variable.ttf`; the binary is unchanged. Shown as «النسخ» in the interface.
- [Aref Ruqaa](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/arefruqaa): regular 400 and bold 700. Shown as «الرقعة» in the interface.

`theme.css` uses private CSS family aliases to avoid clashing with installed fonts. All font URLs are same-origin. The selection changes UI typography only; question/export data and numeric character choices are unchanged.
